description.value:
Your clan is tied to the moon Rhaan - the Book.

The Rhaan clan maintains the history of the clans through story and song, and you have a deeper connection to the Primal energies of the world. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

You can change this cantrip to a different one from the same list once per day by meditating and connecting to the Primal energies of Eberron; this is a 10-minute activity that has the concentrate trait.
